summary: Completed comprehensive testing of cash order creation functionality. Confirmed that the reported Pydantic validation error 422 bug still exists in the backend API when empty datetime strings are sent, despite claims of frontend fix.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 422 Pydantic validation error when empty datetime strings ('') are sent for reach_time/drop_time fields
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks cash and company order creation when frontend sends empty datetime strings
critical_bugs.error_details: datetime_from_date_parsing: Input should be a valid datetime or date, input is too short
critical_bugs.test_evidence: Confirmed via direct API testing - empty strings cause validation failure

minor_issues.issue: Backend returns 200 instead of 201 for successful POST requests
minor_issues.impact: Minor - functionality works but HTTP status code convention not followed

ui_bugs.component: New Order Form - Order Type Dropdown
ui_bugs.issue: Dropdown options (Cash Order/Company Order) not clickable due to overlay interference
ui_bugs.details: Modal overlay intercepts pointer events preventing selection of order type

integration_issues.issue: Frontend may still be sending empty datetime strings to backend despite claimed fix

passed_tests: Backend API basic connectivity and routing
Cash order creation with basic fields (customer_name, phone, order_type)
Cash order creation with all optional fields filled
Cash order creation with null datetime fields (works correctly)
Cash order creation with valid datetime fields (works correctly)
Company order creation with all mandatory fields
Company order validation for missing mandatory fields (correctly rejects)
Frontend navigation to New Order page
Frontend form field population (customer name, phone)
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: The datetime validation bug is NOT fixed. Backend still returns 422 errors when empty datetime strings are sent. Need to either: 1) Fix backend to handle empty strings by converting to null, OR 2) Ensure frontend NEVER sends empty strings (always null). Also fix dropdown overlay issue preventing order type selection in frontend.

success_percentage.backend: 70% - Core functionality works but critical datetime bug remains
success_percentage.frontend: 60% - Login and navigation work but order creation blocked by UI issues
